name: Backpacking ⛺🐻
desc:
[⛵ Boats Update is Live! Grab your boat, take to the water and explore the world of Backpacking like never before!]

Welcome to Backpacking - an open world camping and roleplay game! 

Drive, hike & backpack through immersive scenery and pitch your tent. Enjoy fishing, kayaking, gliding, the wilderness awaits.

Be sure to like the game if you enjoyed for more updates in the future!

Developers: Opplo & Simoon68
